'''Yeyhe''' is a researcher in [[Huaxu Academy]] in the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Yeyhe}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yeyhe:''' Hmm... Tacetite weapons have their limits, you know...
:{{DIcon}} What limit?
:'''Yeyhe:''' Oh, hey! I was just discussing a new weapon project with the department head.
:'''Yeyhe:''' Your timing is impeccable. I have a question for you.
:'''Yeyhe:''' You know what? We just had this epiphany! So, regular Tacetite weapons are like, for one person, right? They don't have much impact on a big battle?
:{{DIcon}} That's right.
:'''Yeyhe:''' But imagine this: a Tacetite weapon that needs a whole team to operate. That would pack a serious punch!
:{{DIcon}} Can it actually move at that size?
:'''Yeyhe:''' Uh... then just fix it!
:{{DIcon}} What if you're surrounded by Tacet Discords?
:'''Yeyhe:''' Uh, hold on a sec...
:'''Yeyhe:''' Ugh, yeah... Still a bunch of kinks to work out...
----
;(In the afternoon)
:'''Yeyhe:''' Man, everytime I read Mr. [[Mortefi]]'s research, I learn something new...
:{{DIcon}} You're the researcher I've seen before.
:'''Yeyhe:''' No way, you were there too?
:'''Yeyhe:''' Did you see Mr. Mortefi shut down that guy making all those crazy demands?
:'''Yeyhe:''' Seriously! Who's the genius behind these thoughtless demands on our R&D?
:'''Yeyhe:''' Only Mr. Mortefi has the guts to challenge them openly, it's pretty cool!
:{{DIcon}} It seems you admire him a lot.
:'''Yeyhe:''' I've always looked up to him. His genius and fearless attitude... I hope to emulate that one day.
:'''Yeyhe:''' Some folks might not get Mr. Mortefi, seeing him as only short-tempered, but there are plenty who secretly admire him.
{{Dialogue End}}
